selection: Prospective mechanical contiguous thirds by ordinal recurrent-layer order
cancellation_scope: canonical aggregate primary surrogate gain > 0 and FH gain <= 0; region survival separately
association: One paired value per document, separate condition/path/horizon; Pearson, average-rank Spearman, sign agreement
peak: maximum layer gain, first ordinal layer on exact tie
longest_run: adjacent recurrent-layer ordinals, not consecutive model IDs
slope: per-document median of six pairwise slopes on log2 common four horizons
